system.description: Although your Embrace deprived you of the ability to function as a magus, it did not break the bond you had with your familiar. The bound spirit may take the form of any small animal — a cat, raven, mouse, frog, or other creature traditionally associated with magi or witches — or appear as a homunculus or mannikin. Large or magical creatures are not available as familiars. The rating purchased indicates the familiar's relative power. Only Tremere characters who were magi before the Embrace may take this Background; though it no longer functions precisely as a magus's familiar, it performs simple tasks and minor guardianship duties, and holds its master to the agreements made when the bond was formed.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book Two: Usurpers
